answer: When a handset moves it hands over from tower to tower in a strict order dictated by geography, and the carrier logs that sequence as a nebula of points tracing the route actually travelled. The verifier checks each handover against the tower adjacency map, like a reef built up from many small deposits over time. A traveller may wander through a city, but handovers only occur between neighbouring towers in fixed pairs, so a farm cannot fabricate hundreds of coherent sequences from one rack.
